youtube_description:
Rikard is the ideal candidate for Regional Medical Director at RMSI having 12 years of experience as a proficient health care manager with extensive knowledge in both corporate and occupational health, specializing in Occupational Medicine. 

Rikard's profession began as a surgeon. He was then seconded as the Chief Medical Officer and personal physician to a prominent member of a Middle-East Royal Family.  
Eager to pursue a career in Occupational Medicine, Rikard's continued studies gained him the Royal College of Physicians MFOM award.  Rikard then completed the MSc in Occupational Health and worked with BUPA as an Occupational Physician and Regional Manager for 5 years.

Rikard's leadership skills were highly acclaimed when he joined ExxonMobil UK in 2004, where he became Occupational Health Manager. Rikard provided support to both the EAME region and the Global Public Health Team.  Ready to venture further afield, Rikard moved to ExxonMobil Dubai office where his work primarily focused on projects in Iraq.

Having joined RMSI in September 2011as Regional Medical Director, Rikard now oversees the Oil and Gas Sector regionally and in particular operations within Iraq.
